options.label: Story file
options.help: Story to load: a filename you dropped in the app's stories/ folder (e.g. Advent.z5), or a full http(s):// URL. Z-code (.z3-.z8, .zblorb) and Glulx (.ulx, .gblorb) are supported. Leave blank to pick from the stories/ folder on screen.

options.label: Read the story aloud
options.help: Speak each new passage through your Wyoming TTS voice. Can be toggled on screen at any time.

options.label: Voice commands
options.help: Show the Speak/Listen control so you can say commands instead of typing them. Needs Wyoming STT.

options.label: TTS host (advanced)
options.help: Advanced: Wyoming TTS host. Leave blank to use the same TTS server as the rest of open-quake (Settings → TTS/STT).

options.label: TTS port (advanced)
options.help: Advanced: Wyoming TTS port. Blank uses the global setting (default 10200).

options.label: STT host (advanced)
options.help: Advanced: Wyoming STT host. Leave blank to use the same STT server as the rest of open-quake (Settings → TTS/STT).

options.label: STT port (advanced)
options.help: Advanced: Wyoming STT port. Blank uses the global setting (default 10300).
